summary:
`todo list --done` now shows only completed items, and `todo list --todo` shows only unfinished ones. I could not run the tests: every `node` command in this session was blocked pending approval. The changes are checked by reading only, so please run `node --test "src/**/*.test.ts"` before relying on them.

Changes:
- **`src/commands/list.ts`**: `runList(dir, args)` parses the flags and filters before formatting. Also added `parseListArgs`.
- **`src/cli.ts`**: passes the args through to `list` and adds the two flags to the usage text.
- **Tests**: unit tests in `list.test.ts` and end-to-end te
